title: Typography, placement and maths for beats
acceptance: A beat's place (centre, caption, top, left, right, none), size (a step from the reader's own), face (by role or id, from faces RISE hosts) and emphasis render on the atom display; a Current's own faces for text and captions apply where a beat names none; unit-tested in the pure modules and witnessed in the browser test.

Maths in what is shown ($…$, $$…$$) is typeset by self-hosted KaTeX, fetched only when a reading has maths, never on first load; a formula is one word of the phrase; until KaTeX loads the source shows; unit-tested.
Two faces added through the font pipeline (Caveat, Barlow Condensed) with their licence rows; every face a model may name is one RISE hosts.
On a phone a left or right column renders as a caption.

evidence.note: The Creative Control design; §10 typography, placement and maths.

activity.summary: Opened after CC-002 merged; built directly against the design.

summary: Beats render their typography: place, size, face and emphasis on the atom display, with maths typeset by KaTeX loaded on demand, and two faces added to the self-hosted set.
